For Participants who had become Disabled or had a Separation from Service due to Retirement or an Involuntary Separation from Service without Cause before the Change in Control, payments for those Performance Cycles that had not completed as of the Change in Control shall be prorated as provided in Section 4.2(a) above but the proration shall be based on target performance.
